description: The bar chart illustrates the average JGA score for two different models, LLama-7B and T5-small, across various turn IDs in a continual dialogue state tracking experiment. The horizontal axis represents the turn ID, ranging from 0 to 26, while the vertical axis indicates the average JGA score, ranging from 0 to 1. The LLama-7B model is represented by orange bars, and the T5-small model is represented by yellow bars. The LLama-7B model consistently shows higher average JGA scores compared to the T5-small model across all turn IDs. The highest average JGA score observed is for the LLama-7B model at turn ID 0, with a score close to 1, while the lowest score for the T5-small model is at turn ID 26, with a score just above 0. The chart does not provide any additional information on the context or specific dialogue turns, nor does it indicate any sorting or emphasis on particular bars.
